claim_boundary: Pattern-based source audit of the pinned interrupt controller. It is conservative engineering evidence and does not replace netlist-aware commercial CDC/RDC signoff.

findings.message: Interrupt inputs enter one sampling register without a two-stage synchronizer.
Raw interrupt inputs drive combinational wake-up logic.
Asynchronous reset assertion is present; reset release synchronization belongs to the SoC integration contract and remains unproven.

required_repairs: Add or instantiate reviewed synchronizers for interrupt sources that are asynchronous to clk_i.
Define the wake-up path CDC protocol and prove pulse/level capture semantics.
Synchronize reset deassertion per clock domain and verify RDC structurally.
Re-run functional interrupt gates after integration and use a dedicated CDC/RDC checker.
